asks.label: Additional comments
asks.value: Combined Research Run A — V01 validation trial per docs/pipeline v2/VALIDATION_TRIAL_PACKETS.md (frozen 6-adult Tokyo food scenario). Operational validation data, not a live traveler request. Frozen intent: (1) food is the top trip priority; (2) one Saturday anchor dinner is worth planning the day around when quality difference is material; (3) food quality outranks shortest travel time, but logistics and booking friction must still be explicit; (4) casual meals stay low-friction — do not turn every lunch into a reservation project; (5) party size is six — a venue whose real seating/booking rules make six implausible must be rejected or caveated; (6) preserve a genuinely exceptional but inconvenient option as Worth the Effort/Detour when evidence supports it instead of silently deleting it for convenience; (7) no cuisine or neighborhood is pre-selected merely to make the test easier.
